control_profile: Controls off with a lagged BTC router, fixed component weights, and bear-only short gating: negative own-price momentum, at least four confirmed names, and a fourteen-day refresh.
falsifier: The low-coordinate, slow-refresh point loses money after doubled costs, produces nonpositive short gross PnL, or falls below fifty basis points of gross edge per turnover.
formation_horizon: 168 completed 8-hour returns with 42-bar momentum and bear-only short confirmation, 6-bar reversal, and 126-bar downside components
hypothesis: A shorter router and signal history with a fourteen-day refresh should test whether the bear-only absolute-downtrend short mechanism survives a low-coordinate, lower-turnover boundary without forcing bull, chop, or stress hedges.
rebalance_horizon: every fourteen days at 00:00 UTC, anchored to the Monday Unix epoch week
